narr: A stalled out boundary late evening on the 16th resulted in continued heavy rainfall from central Butler County to central Scott County with the longest duration heavy rainfall rates located between Dudley and Bloomfield in Stoddard County. Rainfall amounts of 2-4 inches occurred in that area within 3 hours, resulting in flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding of U.S. 60 occurred east of Dudley. The heaviest rainfall rates during the evening occurred just to the north between Dudley and Bloomfield.
lsr: Flash flooding reported on US 60. Water has since receded. Time approximate.
